_about: OFF-2 · every table an outbox action (OFF-5 §2, QUEUED) writes, and what makes a repeated send leave ONE row. kind 'key' = (owner, idempotency_key) UNIQUE, owned by OFF-2; 'natural' = the pair IS the fact, a repeat is the same row; 'update-only' = the action is an UPDATE to a fixed value. scripts/db-off2-idempotency-check.mjs checks the 'key' entries in git; supabase/migrations/PROBE_off2_idempotency.sql checks every entry live. Adding a QUEUED action means adding its table here, in the same PR.

user_notifications.reason: UPDATE … SET is_read = true is the same row however often it is sent

feed_events.reason: the tracker makes each event row's primary key (UUID v4) once, when the event is recorded, and every resend carries it; feed_events_pkey turns a repeat into ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING — a resend is the same row

feed_signal_events.action: signals: time on post, skip, watch %, share click, profile visit (S12-F1)
feed_signal_events.reason: the tracker makes each signal row's primary key (UUID v4) once, when the signal is recorded, and every resend carries it; feed_signal_events_pkey turns a repeat into ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING, and the AFTER INSERT fold into the per-viewer aggregates fires only for a row actually inserted — a resend is the same row and counts once

feed_hidden_posts.action: Not interested / Hide post (S12-F1 Extra A)
feed_hidden_posts.reason: feed_hidden_posts_pkey (user_id, post_id): the pair IS the fact; the sender upserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, a resend is the same row

feed_muted_authors.action: mute / unmute an account (S12-F1 Extra D)
feed_muted_authors.reason: feed_muted_authors_pkey (user_id, author_id): mute upserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, unmute deletes by the pair — both repeatable
